references.text: Mentions Zebulun as a bordering tribe, also noted in verse 34 as the southern neighbor of Naphtali
Describes the territory of the tribe of Asher as bordering Naphtali to the west, as mentioned in verse 34
Describes the territory of the tribe of Zebulun as bordering Naphtali to the south
Mentions areas in Issachar and Asher that border the tribes noted in verse 34
Describes the Jordan River as the eastern boundary of the Promised Land, corresponding to 'the Jordan toward the sunrise' in verse 34
Mentions the Jordan Valley as a border area, relevant to the eastern boundary mentioned in verse 34
